description: This file defines the 'File' class within the 'ZipStream\Option' namespace. The class manages options for a file within a zip archive, including comment, compression method, deflate level, timestamp, size, and related methods. It provides getters and setters for its properties and a method to set default options based on an archive.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents file options for a zip archive, including comment, method, deflate level, timestamp, and size.

methods.name: defaultTo
methods.description: Sets default deflate level and timestamp based on the provided archive options.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the file.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the file.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the compression method for the file, defaulting to DEFLATE if none is set.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the compression method for the file.

methods.name: getDeflateLevel
methods.description: Returns the deflate level, defaulting to the archive's default if not set.

methods.name: setDeflateLevel
methods.description: Sets the deflate level for the file.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with the file.

methods.name: setTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.
